body.name: harness-demo-textstats
body.description: A tiny pure-Python text-statistics library with tests and lint config. Deliberately boring: no secrets, no network, no auth or payment code — safe for a first agent run.

task.title: Implement median_word_length
task.goal: textstats.stats.median_word_length currently raises NotImplementedError. Implement it: median length of whitespace-separated words, 0 for empty input. The failing test tests/test_stats.py::test_median_word_length already exists and must pass.
acceptanceCriteria: No files outside src/textstats/ are modified
